notes: Seven features. Scheduled tasks: a curated view of every task with a stance on the well-known ones (telemetry, third-party updaters) and a reversible on/off. Drivers: an inventory that flags drivers three or more years old, and unsigned ones. Firewall: a read-only view of the rules with a flag on broad inbound-allow holes. Event log: recent errors grouped by source with a plain-language note for the common ones. Share this setup: export your applied tweaks to a small file and apply them on another PC behind a preview. Per-process network use on the Network page (needs administrator rights). And you can now delay a slow startup entry until after sign-in from the Startup page.
